name: Census C30 private data center construction spending
unit: millions of dollars, seasonally adjusted annual rate, and monthly not seasonally adjusted
measures: Value of private data center construction put in place. A subcategory of Census Office.
fit: Context only. Construction spending dollars are not megawatts and are not added to a counted kind.

name: Census C30 Census Office total construction spending
unit: millions of dollars, seasonally adjusted annual rate, and monthly not seasonally adjusted
measures: Value of Census Office construction put in place, including general office, data center, and financial. FRED series PROFCONS and TLOFCON mirror the private Census Office annual rate and the total Census Office monthly NSA line.
fit: Context only. Census Office dollars are not added to data center dollars, and neither is a counted megawatt.

name: EIA-860M preliminary monthly electric generator inventory
unit: generator nameplate megawatts and a status code
measures: Monthly supplement to Form EIA-860 listing electric generators and whether they are planned, under construction, or operating.
fit: A plant row counts only under the counting rules. An 860M status is not construction spending and is not derived from dollars.

name: PJM 2028/2029 Base Residual Auction results
measures: Capacity cleared in the 2028/2029 Reliability Pricing Model Base Residual Auction.
fit: Auction capacity is not counted IT load. An interconnection queue position is not a counted megawatt.

name: State commission special contracts
unit: contract terms stated in the order
measures: Regulator orders and special contracts for data center load, including the Michigan Public Service Commission order opened with this entry.
fit: A contract counts only when the row rules say so. The order is not a construction spending series and is not converted to megawatts from dollars.

name: Epoch AI data centers
unit: independent estimates of IT power, compute, and cost
measures: Third party estimates of large AI data centers, built from imagery, permits, and a cost model.
fit: Not a counted row. Not added to a firm total. Not a Census construction series.

name: SEC XBRL capex frames
measures: Company capital expenditure concepts in the XBRL frames API, such as PaymentsToAcquirePropertyPlantAndEquipment.
fit: Company capex is not counted IT load and is not converted to megawatts.
